diagnosis.text: DIAGNOSIS: The cycle completed correctly with nothing to claim, but two bugs compound: (1) `run_step`'s tap_all fast-break exits only the inner loop, so it polls the screen for the full 20s even when all badges are on cooldown; (2) `read_cooldowns_with_retry`'s cross-attempt value dedup uses a 25s-floor/5%-relative tolerance that merges the two ~01:20h wolves (only 20s apart) into one timer, causing a false "low-confidence 2/3" read that forces the daemon to wake hourly instead of waiting for the true soonest cooldown.
